Plain text output format strips markdown syntax

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<h1>Title</h1><p>Some <strong>bold</strong> text.</p>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(output_format: 'Plain'))
puts result.content.inspect
```
